blurb: Helijet offers scheduled helicopter flights between locations such as Nanaimo, Vancouver, and Victoria. They also provide charter flights, air medical transport, and heliport management services. Featured excursions include scenic tours combined with local experiences like wine tours and garden visits.

quotes.text: I needed to attend a business meeting in Victoria and took Helijet from Vancouver Harbour. The flight was absolutely excellent. The pilots were pleasant and did an excellent job with clear briefings. The flights were very smooth there and back even though we travelled through some weather. Keep up the great work!
I love Helijet! All of the staff and pilots are unbelievably friendly and accommodating! The views from up there are unreal.
I have experience with the Company! Very good Manajement and # 1 customer service!!
